notes: Alentejano wines are fruity and smooth, with a full, sturdy body.
About 3,000 hours of sun a year favor ripeness and deep color in the grapes.
Young wines are fruity or floral and grow more complex with age.

blurb.text: A Portuguese regional wine area classed as a Vinho Regional.
